title: Baththa – Vijay Sethupathi, Lijomol Jose Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for Baththa – Vijay Sethupathi, Lijomol Jose — premieres Oct 29, 2026.
body:
• The trailer for Baththa – Vijay Sethupathi, Lijomol Jose dropped October 27, 2026.
  • New Hindi movie premiering Oct 29, 2026 on Netflix India.
  • An eight-year-old boy accidentally locks the dreaded Baththa inside a school restroom. Will Sabari escape Baththa’s wrath when the gangster discovers who’s behind it?

The makers of Baththa – Vijay Sethupathi, Lijomol Jose have released the official trailer, unveiled October 27, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
